paragraphs.text: “I’m happy to leave you in charge for a half-hour or so.” He smiles. “Please don’t issue any books without a valid library card.”
You thank Winters for his trust and continue with your reading for a time. As the light dims, you find yourself yawning in the closeness of the room. Perhaps it is time for a change of material.
Make a Spot Hidden roll. If you succeed, go to 118. If you fail, go to 124.
